teff_K.assumption: Gaia's Multiple Star Classifier fits the BP/RP spectrum with an unresolved binary model and reports the primary's Teff: this assumes the source is a binary, which has not been established for this star. For cool stars (below about 3500 K) molecular absorption (TiO, VO) dominates the BP/RP spectrum and the fit can be biased. The spectrum is a mean over the 34 months of Gaia DR3 observations, so for a Mira variable such as this the value is an average over its pulsation cycles and not the temperature at any one phase, and the 16th to 84th percentile range is the only uncertainty given
teff_K.source: Gaia DR3 astrophysical_parameters teff_msc1 (Multiple Star Classifier), source 1648328016354496384, matched 0.00 arcsec from the SIMBAD position moved to 2016.0 by its proper motion

confidence.formula: C = sum(w_i c_i) / sum(w_i): c is 1 for a measured value or a formula of measured values, a placeholder share for a model-dependent one, and 0 for an assumed, artistic or missing one; the w_i are placeholder weights (D-36, Q-221)
confidence.found: Data for: Spectral class, pulsation period and temperature and colour.
confidence.note: This is how much of the picture rests on data. It is not the probability that the picture is correct.
confidence.weights_note: Placeholder weights: they come from the approved prototype until a sensitivity sweep replaces them (D-36).

layers.description: Teff to sRGB through a blackbody colour calculation (R7.5).
layers.formula: Planck(Teff) integrated 380-780 nm against the CIE 1931 2-degree colour-matching functions (Wyman, Sloan & Shirley 2013 fit), XYZ -> linear sRGB (D65), clipped at 0, brightest channel = 1 (R7.5)

layers.description: Assumption: linear limb darkening, I(mu) = 1 - 0.6 * (1 - mu) (R7.5).

rgb.assumption: teff_K is model dependent; colour by Planck(Teff) integrated 380-780 nm against the CIE 1931 2-degree colour-matching functions (Wyman, Sloan & Shirley 2013 fit), XYZ -> linear sRGB (D65), clipped at 0, brightest channel = 1 (R7.5)
